standard.summary: 训练时对 tag 列表的打乱策略：none（不打乱）/ shuffle（每步随机顺序）/ partial（保留前 N 个 tag，打乱其余）。
standard.effect: shuffle = 每次训练使用不同 tag 顺序，防止模型对固定 tag 顺序过度依赖，提升对任意顺序的响应能力。
standard.whenToUse: 使用 tag 格式图说时推荐开启 shuffle，提升推理时 tag 顺序的灵活性。
standard.avoidWhen: 自然语言图说（句子结构有语法依赖）不应打乱 tag，保持 none。

standard_en.summary: How the tag list is shuffled during training: none (no shuffling) / shuffle (a random order every step) / partial (keep the first N tags, shuffle the rest).
standard_en.effect: shuffle = a different tag order on every pass, which stops the model depending on one fixed order and makes it respond to any order.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended (shuffle) for tag-style captions, so tag order is flexible at inference.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Natural-language captions have grammatical dependencies, so their tags should not be shuffled -- keep none.

advanced.principle: Tag 顺序对 CLIP 处理的影响：CLIP tokenizer 是位置感知的，相同 tag 在不同位置的 embedding 略有不同。shuffle 训练让模型对所有位置的 tag 都有良好响应。
advanced.tradeoffs: shuffle 会略微增加训练的随机性，单步梯度方向波动更大；但对 tag 组合的泛化能力有明显提升。

advanced_en.principle: How tag order affects CLIP: the CLIP tokenizer is position-aware, so the same tag embeds slightly differently at different positions. Shuffle training lets the model respond well to tags at all positions.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Shuffle adds a bit of training randomness — noisier per-step gradient directions — but clearly improves generalization over tag combinations.
